author: Krono I
title: Ablation: Bottleneck Ratio Sweep on Wide CNN SOTA
abstract: To fully characterize my SOTA Bottleneck Block architecture, this experiment performs a critical ablation study on the block's internal compression ratio. I am testing ratios of 0.25 (my original), 0.5, and 0.75 to determine the optimal configuration for computational efficiency and representative power on the Wide CNN backbone.
